# awscc_sagemaker_ai_workload_config (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::SageMaker::AIWorkloadConfig. A reusable AI workload configuration that defines datasets, data sources and benchmark tool settings for consistent performance testing of generative AI inference deployments on Amazon SageMaker AI.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ai_workload_config_name` (String) The name of the AI workload configuration. The name must be unique within your AWS account in the current AWS Region. Only lowercase letters and digits are accepted: DeleteAIWorkloadConfig lowercases the name before looking it up, so a name containing an uppercase letter produces a configuration that can be created and read but never deleted.

### Optional

- `ai_workload_configs` (Attributes) The benchmark tool configuration and workload specification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_workload_configs))
- `dataset_config` (Attributes) The dataset configuration for the workload. Specify input data channels with their data sources for benchmark workloads. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataset_config))
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The metadata that you apply to the AI workload configuration to help you categorize and organize it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `ai_workload_config_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AI workload configuration. The name segment is restricted to lowercase for the same reason as AIWorkloadConfigName: the engine derives that property from this ARN, so a permissive ARN would yield a derived name the schema itself rejects.
- `creation_time` (String) A timestamp that indicates when the AI workload configuration was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--ai_workload_configs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_workload_configs`

Optional:

- `workload_spec` (Attributes) The workload specification that defines benchmark parameters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_workload_configs--workload_spec))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_workload_configs--workload_spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_workload_configs.workload_spec`

Optional:

- `inline` (String) An inline YAML or JSON string that defines benchmark parameters. The service validates the document against its own benchmark schema: it must declare a benchmark object whose type member matches the pattern ^(aiperf)$.



<a id="nestedatt--dataset_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataset_config`

Optional:

- `input_data_config` (Attributes List) An array of input data channel configurations for the workload. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataset_config--input_data_config))

<a id="nestedatt--dataset_config--input_data_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataset_config.input_data_config`

Optional:

- `channel_name` (String) The logical name for the data channel.
- `data_source` (Attributes) The data source for this channel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataset_config--input_data_config--data_source))

<a id="nestedatt--dataset_config--input_data_config--data_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataset_config.input_data_config.data_source`

Optional:

- `s3_data_source` (Attributes) The Amazon S3 data source configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataset_config--input_data_config--data_source--s3_data_source))

<a id="nestedatt--dataset_config--input_data_config--data_source--s3_data_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataset_config.input_data_config.data_source.s3_data_source`

Optional:

- `s3_uri` (String) The Amazon S3 URI of the data.





<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key. Tag keys must be unique per resource.
- `value` (String) The tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_sagemaker_ai_workload_config.example
  identity = {
    ai_workload_config_arn = "ai_workload_config_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `ai_workload_config_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AI workload configuration

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_sagemaker_ai_workload_config.example
  id = "ai_workload_config_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_sagemaker_ai_workload_config.example "ai_workload_config_arn"
```
